values.binNote: The wiki's monster damage is 200% of the base per-strike damage (BelvethE#DamagePerStrike flat=[10,12,14,16,18], ad=0.12), i.e. multiplied by BelvethE.MonsterMod=2, giving base=[20,24,28,32,36] and ad coef=0.24. No bin row states these doubled numbers directly; they are derived by applying MonsterMod as a multiplier to DamagePerStrike, consistent with the wiki's '200% damage to monsters' text.

mechanics.claim: Royal Maelstrom rapidly slashes at the nearest enemy with the lowest current health percentage, up to the strike cap, applying on-hit, on-attack, and spell effects on each slash.
mechanics.quote: she rapidly slashes at the nearest enemy with the lowest {{as|'''current''' health}} percentage for up to 6 ... times over the duration ... and applies {{tip|on-hit}}, {{tip|on-attack}}, and {{tip|spell effects|spell}} effects

mechanics.claim: Bel'Veth cannot perform slashes while affected by cast-inhibiting crowd control, reducing damage output during the channel.
mechanics.quote: '''Bel'Veth''' cannot perform slashes while she is affected by {{tip|cast-inhibiting crowd control|cast-inhibiting crowd control}}.

mechanics.claim: Royal Maelstrom deals 200% damage to monsters, applies life steal, and is affected by critical strike modifiers.
mechanics.quote: ''Royal Maelstrom'' deals 200% damage to {{tip|monsters}}, {{tip|applies lifesteal|applies}} {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}}, and is affected by {{tip|critical strike}} modifiers.

mechanics.claim: The ability's cooldown starts on cast, but cannot be reduced by Navori Flickerblade/Transcendence during its own effect.
mechanics.quote: Despite this ability's cooldown starts on cast, it cannot be reduced by {{iis|Navori Flickerblade}} {{nie|Transcendence}} during the effect of this ability.

mechanics.claim: Royal Maelstrom can be recast to end early, or ends automatically after its duration or when Bel'Veth casts another ability.
mechanics.quote: ''Royal Maelstrom'' can be recast within the duration, and does so automatically afterwards or when '''Bel'Veth''' casts an ability.
